title: 2022 Fed Hiking Cycle
storyline: Inflation hits 40-year highs and the Fed raises rates at the fastest pace since the 1980s. Stocks and bonds fall together, the dollar soars, and Hong Kong is squeezed by both US rates and China's zero-COVID policy before a sharp year-end reversal.

regime.name: Inflation overshoot
regime.description: Inflation is far above target and central banks are behind the curve. Equity valuations are high and bond yields are very low.
